answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a willow as the anchor of the cost.
